The '''holoviewer''' or holoviewer screen was a type of [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] technology that linked up to the [[holo-sensor]]s of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]]. During the mission to colonize the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] used the holoviewer screen in the [[Mantaris-class amphibious medium transport]]. This particular holoviewer received images from both halves of [[ER-1C]], one half monitored the plants and animals and the other half monitored the new [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] colony.
